blocks.text: FAQs for a Box Spring Removal Service

items.q: 1. How much does box spring removal cost?
a: Pricing typically depends on the size of the box spring and your location. Most removals start at a flat rate for a single item, with discounts available if you’re removing a mattress and box spring together. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote.

items.q: 2. Do I need to move the box spring outside before pickup?
a: No. Our team handles all the heavy lifting. We’ll remove the box spring directly from your bedroom, basement, or wherever it’s located — no need to drag it to the curb or garage.

items.q: 3. What happens to my box spring after it's removed?
a: We prioritize eco-friendly disposal. Whenever possible, box springs are broken down for recycling — the wood, metal springs, and fabric can often be repurposed. Items in good condition may be donated to local charities instead of ending up in a landfill.

items.q: 4. Can you remove a mattress and box spring at the same time?
a: Absolutely. In fact, most customers bundle the two. Removing both items in a single trip is more convenient and usually more cost-effective than scheduling separate pickups.

items.q: 5. How quickly can you pick up my box spring?
a: We offer flexible scheduling, including same-day and next-day appointments in most service areas. Simply call or book online, choose a time window that works for you, and we’ll send a text or call when our team is on the way.
